name: Chroma

profile.Education: Bachelor's Degree in Communication Design - LASALLE
profile.Civilian Occupation: Freelance Graphic Designer; Guardian Merchandise Designer at LumaSoft
profile.Signature Ability: Spectrum Signal; Produces coloured markers and projections for communication and evacuation
profile.Fear: Being unable to protect Mira despite possessing Guardian abilities.
profile.Mentor: Luma Ophiuchus; Luma Prism is not officially registered.
profile.Close bonds: Mira Tan (Luma Iris), Luma Ophiuchus; later members of Wildflowers.
profile.Rivals: A friendly creative rival from his civilian profession; identity TBD.
profile.Loves: creative expression, meaningful design projects, peaceful moments together, and seeing his wife happy.
profile.Likes: Graphic design, interesting colour combinations, visual effects, experimenting with layouts, creative challenges, collaborating with others, and supporting Emberbuds activities.
profile.Dislikes: Unnecessarily complicated instructions, rushed design approvals, poor communication, creative restrictions without explanation, and having his work repeatedly changed without clear direction.
profile.Hobbies: Digital illustration, experimenting with typography and colour palettes, photography, visiting exhibitions, collecting design references, and occasionally creating personal artwork.
profile.Personality: Marcus is creative, observant, and easygoing, with a patient and adaptable personality. He enjoys expressing himself through art and design, often noticing visual details that others overlook. Although generally relaxed, he takes pride in his work and can become surprisingly particular about composition, colour, and small finishing touches. He has a gentle sense of humour and enjoys lightheartedly teasing Mira, especially when she becomes overly enthusiastic about the Emberbuds. Despite occasionally complaining about her numerous design requests, he willingly supports her projects and enjoys seeing how happy they make her. As a Guardian, Marcus prefers practical support and creative solutions over direct confrontation, using his abilities to protect others without attracting unnecessary attention. He values his independence but remains dependable when his assistance is needed. His marriage to Mira is built on mutual respect, affection, and a comfortable understanding of each other's interests.
Personality Example: When Mira asks Marcus to adjust an Emberbuds poster for the fifth time, he sighs dramatically before opening his design software again. Despite his complaints, he continues improving the artwork until she is satisfied.
During a Guardian training session, Chroma experiments with several arrangements of coloured light, eventually discovering an unexpected application that even his mentor had not considered.
profile.Core Idea of character: A Guardian who uses creativity to change how others see the world.
Quotes: "There are more ways to protect someone than standing in front of them."
profile.Background:
Marcus Tan is a freelance graphic designer who met Mira through a creative project when she was in her late twenties. Their friendship gradually developed into romance, and they eventually married. Marcus frequently supports Mira's passion for the Emberbuds, assisting with posters, logos, merchandise layouts, and promotional designs.
Around the age of 35, Marcus self-awakened as an Air Guardian and later trained under Luma Ophiuchus. His powers developed into the Prism–Chroma branch, allowing him to manipulate light, colour, and visual effects through precise Air magic. He eventually became a Full-Fledged Guardian, although he continued prioritising his civilian career and accepting independent Guardian assignments only when suitable.
Mira knows that Marcus is a Guardian and trained under Ophiuchus, but initially does not know that his Guardian identity is Luma Chroma. When Mira later awakens as Luma Iris through Blossom, their Guardian lives become more closely connected. Marcus gradually becomes involved with Wildflowers as an associate while continuing to support Mira both as her husband and as a fellow Guardian.
